title: mutant-coupling-null: a chance-corrected test of mutant-real-fault coupling
description: Research artifact for a chance-corrected test of mutant-real-fault coupling. The primary question is whether a fault-triggering test satisfies the historical unique-kill coupling criterion more often than a coverage-matched ordinary non-triggering test on the same kill matrices. Author identity, ORCID, affiliation, GitHub remote, and archival DOI are HUMAN_REQUIRED. This initialization deposit contains no experimental results and does not redistribute third-party benchmark data.
